content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the introduction of pre-allocated hash elements in the BPF hash map implementation, which altered the expected behavior of the `bpf_map_update_elem()` function. Users anticipated that they could update elements in the hash map without needing to check if the map was full. However, the new implementation did not allow updates when the map was full, leading to failures in scenarios where users were trying to update existing elements. The patch restores the previous behavior by allowing updates to existing elements even when the map is full, using extra pre-allocated elements to handle such cases.
